description: This file defines the ReminderEntity class used in the Orleans Reminders Cosmos DB integration. It includes properties for reminder metadata and static methods for constructing IDs and partition keys.

classes.name: ReminderEntity
classes.description: Represents a reminder entity stored in Cosmos DB, with properties for partition key, service ID, grain ID, name, start time, period, and grain hash, along with static methods for ID construction.

methods.name: ConstructId
methods.description: Constructs a unique ID for the reminder based on grain ID and reminder name.

methods.name: ConstructPartitionKey
methods.description: Constructs the partition key for Cosmos DB based on service ID and grain ID.
